_comment: Known drift per frame/case: the harness fails when a case gets worse than this (plus slack: 2.0% pixels, 1.0 px bounds, 0.5 px font). Regenerate with -PvitroParityUpdateBaseline=true; keep or write each "reason". An update records regressions too: read the diff before committing it, and keep the entries of cases with an open regression. #794 empties this file.

mirror/entities.reason: display precision only: HA formats 1.1111 °C / 61.0 W with the entity registry's display_precision (1.1 °C, 61 W), which the harness doesn't capture, so Vitro shows the raw state. Layout and card height match

mirror/glance.reason: display precision only: 20.6849 °C / 48.35% where HA uses the registry's display_precision (20.7 °C, 48%), not captured by the harness. Layout and card height match

mirror/heading.reason: display precision only: the temperature badge shows the raw 20.6849 °C (HA: display_precision, 20.7 °C), which widens it and shifts the next badge

mirror/mushroom-chips.reason: display precision only: the first chip shows the raw 20.6849 °C (HA: 20.7 °C), which widens it and shifts the other chips ~70 px; each chip's content matches

mirror/thermostat.reason: the dial's texts (Off, 17.5 °C) are drawn on its canvas, so the harness can't find them as text runs; pixels 0.2%

mirror/tile-sensor.reason: display precision only: 523.0 ppm where HA shows the registry's display_precision (523 ppm), not captured by the harness

mirror/vertical-stack.reason: display precision only: the power tile shows the raw 61.0 W (HA: the registry's display_precision, 61 W), not captured by the harness. Heights match
